standards.applies_because: BLE intentional radiator (FCC 15C) and digital device (15B)
BLE radio sold in the EU (RED)
Electrical safety of the ICT device
Lithium cell shipped inside the product
US button/coin cell battery safety (Reese's Law) if a coin cell is used
Splash/immersion claim (IP67 target) for a pocket device

risks.mitigation: Tune the advertising interval, measure sleep current on the first PCBA

risks.risk: Antenna detuned by the wallet / body
risks.mitigation: Antenna matching network tuned in the enclosure, not on the bare board

risks.risk: Card flexes and cracks the PCB or cell
risks.mitigation: Stiff 0.6 mm board with components away from the flex line, flex test
Implement anti-stalking behaviour (sound alert, platform unwanted-tracking spec)

steps: Flash the firmware on an nRF52 dev kit, measure sleep current with a power profiler
Print the card shells in tough SLA resin
Assemble the quick-turn PCBA with the thin cell
Tune the antenna match inside the closed card
Flex and drop test, then a 2-week battery soak
